post.caption:
Cheese, curd, bread, coffee, chocolate, soy sauce and pickles are all made by microbes eating something first. Fermentation converts sugars into acids, alcohol and gases, which preserves the food and creates flavour compounds that do not otherwise exist. There is no unfermented chocolate that tastes like chocolate. And humans worked all of it out thousands of years before anyone knew microbes existed. We were running biotechnology blind and getting very good at it.
